snippet.title: Country Story by Playfish
snippet.description:
Play now at http://apps.facebook.com/countrystory

It's time to get away from it all - the hustle and bustle, the noise and the smog. Feel the stresses and strains of everyday life melt away as you enjoy the tranquil pleasures of your very own country home. Country Story lets you take a break any time of the day just to tend to your crops and your animals, visit your friends' homes and simply breathe in the country air. Which animals you'd like to keep and which crops you'd rather grow is entirely up to you - it's your home to run exactly as you choose and no two are quite the same. All crops and animals have their own particular needs so you can share your ideas and findings with your friends! Play now at www.playfish.com/countrystory
